description: This file defines the ViewLabels class, which extends ViewModulefields to manage and display label editing interfaces within the SuiteCRM Module Builder environment. It includes methods for rendering label data, handling language files, and managing module-specific label configurations.

classes.name: ViewLabels
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the display and editing of labels within the Module Builder, including gathering labels from various layout definitions, language files, and subpanels, and rendering the labels editing interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module, including the module name and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method for preparing and displaying the labels editing interface, gathering labels from layouts, subpanels, language files, and assigning them to the Smarty template.

methods.name: getVariableMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of layout variable types to their descriptive names, with adjustments based on specific modules.
